source_metadata.title: Evaluation of Cyclosporine for the Treatment of DRESS Syndrome

notes: No cross-batch merging was required because the target article is short enough for a single semantic extraction pass.

The source describes 4 age- and sex-matched controls per cyclosporine case but reports 21 corticosteroid controls for 5 cyclosporine cases; this internal count/matching mismatch is retained as an appraisal issue rather than repaired.

extraction_limitations: The downloaded PDF contains portions of adjacent JAMA Dermatology letters on pages 704 and 706; only the Nguyen et al DRESS research letter was atomized.
The article reports descriptive group means and SDs but does not report inferential between-group effect estimates, confidence intervals, or p values for the outcomes in Table 2.
Adverse effects causing cyclosporine discontinuation are not specified by type in the source.
No funding statement for the target article was visible in the supplied three-page source; no funding atom was invented.
schema_gaps: ArmObservation can store group means but not SDs directly; SDs are preserved in canonical statements and original_result_text.
The model has no dedicated field for matching ratio or study-design metadata; these are preserved in method atoms and tags.
